description.text: AI-written synthesis of the official page retrieved in this pass, prepared by the collecting assistant: At the PorterShed, you can Start, Scale, and Succeed – and work your way, in Galway At the PorterShed, we are all about creating high-value sustainable jobs that have a positive impact on Galway and the surrounding areas. Helping to create tech jobs, especially indigenous tech, are a key part of our goal – and we are also big supporters of welcoming multinational companies to use the PorterShed office spaces as landing bases. We want companies to come here to start their ideas, to grow, and to scale. Whether we are providing space for start-ups to develop in, pointing founders in the right direction, or amplifying their wins, we want to see them succeed; their success is our success, and we love being part of their journeys. About Us Jobs Created 0 + Inward Investment 0 M Hosted Events 0 Visitors K 0 + We love seeing new faces come through our doors, and we have a diverse range of membership options to suit all kinds of preferences. Our Full-Time packages are ideal for the start-up entrepreneur who wants to make every moment count, our Virtual options would suit those who want to dip back into office life, and our Corporate membership is ideal for members of the wider startup community who want to connect with and support tech talent. We also provide soft landing for FDI companies who want to become embedded in the local tech scene – reach out to a member of our team to discuss No application form was opened, and this record does not add a deadline, investment instrument, or eligibility rule beyond that quoted text.
